name: tessary-agent-sandbox-template
description: E2B v2 SDK template for the agent sandbox: runs OpenCode for RCA and triage, over a cloned repo when the caller sends one. The `opencode` CLI is installed globally by the template build and driven over @opencode-ai/sdk. NO `type: module` here: the agent scripts are CommonJS and the host launcher (SANDBOX_BACKEND=local) runs them from this directory, where an ESM package default breaks `require` instantly (E2B never sees this file — the template copies the scripts alone); agent-stream.js reaches the ESM-only SDK through a dynamic import instead. build.ts runs via tsx, which handles its ESM syntax regardless.
